requirements.general_text: STPM: Interview  Pass SPM or its equivalent with credit in Bahasa Melayu and  Pass STPM or its equivalent, with minimum Grade C in 2 subjects including Pengajian Am/Kertas Am (General Studies/General Paper) or minimum 2.00 CGPA Pass Ministry of Education Matriculation or MSU Foundation Programme, or other Foundation Programme or its equivalent from higher learning institution with minimum 2.00 CGPA;  Diploma in related field from Higher Learning Institution or other institution recognised by MSU Senate with minimum 2.00 CGPA;  Pass The South Australian Matriculation (SAM) with minimum score of 65% ;  Pass Canadian Pre University Programme (CPU) with minimum score of 80%;  Pass Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with at least grade B in 5 subjects;  Other equivalent qualification recognised by the Malaysian Government.
